card.line: The Rocks of the Wild Goats was a region near En-gedi where Saul hunted David, and where David chose to spare the king's life.

moments.title: Saul Hunts for David
moments.text: Saul took three thousand chosen men from all Israel. He went to look for David and his men in the region of the Rocks of the Wild Goats.

moments.title: David Spares Saul in the Cave
moments.text: Saul went into a cave to relieve himself, where David and his men were hiding. David cut off a corner of Saul's robe, but he would not harm the LORD's anointed and held his men back.

moments.title: David Calls Out to Saul
moments.text: David went out of the cave and called, "My lord the king!" When Saul looked behind him, David bowed facedown in reverence.
